opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user profile and their top repo, then compose a lead email to hiring@example.com summarizing followers, top repo and latest post for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username, press Enter
Note follower count, latest post and open top repo (stars, language)
Switch to mail, fill To, Subject 'Lead for <role>: <user>' and Body with summary

instances.values: karpathy, ML Research Engineer, top repo nanoGPT

opportunities.name: Wikipedia person lookup plus Wayback snapshot
opportunities.description: Search a person on Wikipedia, then look up a company's homepage in the Wayback Machine for a given year and record findings in notes.
steps: Search the person's name on Wikipedia
Open the Internet Archive and enter the company URL
Pick the year and a snapshot date
Add a note combining the person's facts and archived page text
